prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Mage survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the approved four-view Mage identity reference. Image 2 contains the exact shipped seed for this facing, serving only as an identity/facing reference, not a scene to reproduce. Keep the same young adult man, pale face, short tousled black hair with a shaved side, broad dark indigo-blue layered robe and shoulder cape, brown leather cross strap/belt, brown boots/gloves, ONE rigid brass sun-wheel staff in his physical LEFT hand, and one CLOSED brass-brown book tethered at his physical RIGHT hip. Right hand stays free. Preserve body proportions, the slightly elevated game camera, staff design and all asymmetric equipment. No extra staff, book, firearm, shield or weapon-hand change. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet cloth planes and a few selective contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive scratches, decorative filigree, tiny noise, magic particles, glow or flashy effects. Maintain two connected arms and two legs, a rigid staff shaft and attached hands throughout.
Every pose faces SOUTH, toward the viewer, matching the upper-left reference. Staff stays in the physical LEFT hand on viewer RIGHT; closed book stays at the RIGHT hip on viewer LEFT.
Draw exactly 6 complete full-body poses as one coherent dash animation sheet, arranged in a clear 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Fill exactly these 6 cells with no extra figure. Action: One short grounded directional dodge: 1 full upright ready stance, 2 compress knees and lean into the facing direction, 3 fast long low step with cape trailing, 4 compact weight-transfer step, 5 plant landing foot and absorb momentum, 6 recover upright ready stance. All six poses keep the SAME facing, camera and physical LEFT-hand staff, held securely with a controlled angle. Staff is not a pole vault and does not bend. No rolling, somersault, clones, speed lines, smoke, trails or magic effects.
Use the full upright neutral pose as the common size reference; every frame shares one character scale. Keep roomy clear gutters and padding around EVERY full silhouette and the ENTIRE staff, plus a consistent ground baseline within each row. Crouched and lying bodies must retain their natural lower height, never be stretched to standing height. BACKGROUND: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside the figures, including between legs and around staff/book. No floor, ground shadow, scenery, haze, glow, vignette, colored backdrop, checker pattern, text, labels, numbers or grid lines. Preserve clean ink edges and matte gouache inside the silhouettes. Deliver the entire coherent sheet, never isolated unrelated illustrations.
